title: Concept: Video loaded over plaintext HTTP
description: A video element that points at plaintext HTTP in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The stream is unauthenticated, so a network attacker can swap the clip shown next to a payment instruction.
applicability: Deployments that render a video element that points at plaintext HTTP into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The stream is unauthenticated, so a network attacker can swap the clip shown next to a payment instruction.
